label: dry-P01-full
brief: A launch campaign for a new luxury perfume, 'Noctis' by Maison Verre. We need: (1) a premium product shot of the bottle, a tall faceted smoked-glass flacon with a brushed gold cap; (2) a poster for the launch using that bottle, with the words 'Noctis' and 'Maison Verre · Paris' and the line 'Available 14 December'; (3) a 30-second widescreen film in three separate scenes with the same bottle: a woman spraying it at a dressing table at dusk, the bottle on wet black stone in rain, and a man closing the cap in a car at night, each scene its own clip; the last few seconds of the film show the current offer '20% off at launch' over the picture, then end on the brand logo, a thin gold 'MV' monogram inside a circle on black with 'Maison Verre' beneath it in small capitals, exactly; a calm, low voice says 'Noctis. For the hours that are yours.' over the ending.

story.setting: Contemporary Paris moves from dusk into a rainy night across three connected private spaces. An ivory dressing table beside a west-facing apartment window overlooks the street where the car will later wait. Elise, a woman with a dark bob, an ivory silk blouse, and a fine gold bracelet, prepares there alone. Below the apartment, a wet black stone ledge beneath the entrance canopy catches rain from its edge. A parked car with charcoal leather seats and a rain-streaked side window waits beside that entrance. Adrien, a man with close-cropped dark hair, a black wool coat, and a silver signet ring, sits inside. The perfume is always a tall faceted smoked-glass flacon with a brushed gold cap. Widescreen 16:9 framing, restrained movement, deep charcoal shadows, muted violet dusk, and warm gold highlights give every image the same quiet luxury.

story.title: Noctis — The Hours That Are Yours
story.narration: As daylight leaves the room, take a moment for yourself. A touch at the neck. The evening is yours. Smoked glass catches the rain. Brushed gold holds the light. Discover Noctis by Maison Verre, Paris. Available fourteen December. Close the cap. Leave the day behind. Make the night your own, with twenty percent off at launch. Noctis. For the hours that are yours.
